Hey, what's with the long face? ...What?\nOh, you've got nothing to do? Great! I've just\nfinished my work, so let's take a tea break.
...Huh? How long have you been living in here,\nyou ask? Since when this city was built. Longer\nthan Romfh. Yea, I've been helping the partisan.
People come and go here. I can remember all kinds\nof kids... Good girl, rowdy boy...\nI hope they're all happy now...
Oh, you look glum. What's wrong? ...You look glum\ntoo, you say? Huh! Well, that could be right.\nI'll make some tea. Let's talk.
I like this place when it's busy but when people\nare gone, I feel like as if a fire went out.\nThat makes me feel depressed...
But, I still don't wanna leave here...\nIsn't it too sad to find no one in this place\nif their souls came back to here, right?
hey, the tea  is getting cold.\nDrink it and cheer up!\nYou know what you have to do now!
Hi, welcome. What can I do for you?\nNo need to hurry. Take your time.
Thanks. Come again anytime...\nWhat? You don't need to buy anything.\nJust come to chat with me.

Welcome to our hideout, Hora Diomedea.\nI am Romfh Rune, the leader of the partisan.
Partisan... What are you actually doing...?
Let me guide here first. Let's talk after that...
Oh, you're new comers? Alright. Welcome.\nMy name is Adala. I'm running a store here.\nNice to meet you.
Stop by here when you need something.\nI think you can find all the things... well,\nalmost all the things you'll need.
Whoaaa... I expected that it would be a small\nhideout but it looks like a town underground...
Since when the Empire of Lyark occupied our land\nand built Ultimea City, we've been living in\nHora Diomedea and...
fighting against them as a partisan...
...But recently, Venena the Lil Empress acceded\nto the throne and they are capturing and hurting\ninnocent people...
It could be provocation or warning to us...\nAnyway, we can never forgive them!!
I've seen your fight and I can tell you are quite\nskilled.
It could be some kind of fate to meet you.\nCould you give us a hand?
Yea, our foes are everywhere on the surface.\nWe can't investigate the empire without\npeople who know much about here.
Let's cooperate with them so they can join forces\nwith the partisan in Klaspe Slum and Resistle\ntroops!
That would be helpful! Thank you!!
Oh, the big sis! You're gonna fight together\nwith us? But you look like a merchant.\nDon't become our drag.
What did you say, little brat?!\nHave you heard of manners?\nWhy not introduce yourself first?!
Oh, oh, I'm sorry. I'm Nino.\nNice to meet you. Ah...
Pelulu! ...Well, okay. Nice to meet you.
Oh, I've just found a nice small duo.
Hello, I'm Pasca. Your fight was awesome.\nI can't wait to fight together...
Hm? What are you doing, Lepage?\nCome and greet them.
They say they cooperate with us, didn't hear?!
I'm sorry if he made you feel bad...
Lepage is so shy with new people.
Lyark army is attacking our supporter's mansion!\nWe've gotta save him!!
We'll charge into there as the advance troop!\nFollow us!!
I just wanted to ask you for help.\nHave you heard about the situation from Nino?
...Alright. Lufenas family is a famous noble\nfamily of Reistle and secretly supporting\nthe partisan.
They have great influence in the empire, so the\narmy was unable to deal with them but...\nLooks like the army has run out of patience...
According to the report, the mansion was occupied\nand people including the head of the family are\nunder house arrest. Can you help us release them?
What?\nI'll stay here. I would be a drag if I...
Oh, you worry about what I said yesterday.\nIt was a joke! We are short of hands, so\nwe want you to help people evacuate!!
You're going on a mission? Good luck!\nBut don't waste your life!
Phew, finally it's done.\nToo many places to repair.\nWhy are they so many?
It's been long since they were built.\nThis place is underground and humid, so the wooden\nparts rot easily.
By the way, you look like you enjoy working.
Usually, I don't like working.\nBut today, you helped me out so...\nI felt like I was with my real sister...
What are you saying?!\n...? Where's your real sister?
Now? She's buried in the suburb of Klaspe...\nThe people in my village were attacked by Lyark\narmy and tried to escape into Klaspe Slum but...
They were shot in front of there and...
Never mind! I'm sorry I'm saying something wet.\nWell, I don't feel lonely when I'm with everybody.
Are you alright?! Get yourself together!!
Alright, this will do.\nCaptain, the treatment is done.
Thanks, Adala... By the way, your clothes look\nlike you are concerned in Ultimea.\nWhy did you come to here?
I was a researcher in Brahe Laboratory...\nDreadful human experiments have been conducted\nfor a long time and...
They began to create bioweapons made of a live\nhuman being, not like Demi Machinas made with\nanimal or human bodies...
A lot of people have become victims already...\nWhat is worse, partisans were brought to the lab\nfrom the jail as research materials the other day.
I've had it! I don't wanna see such frightful\nscenes!! Please! Destroy the lab and save them!!
Captain! What are you gonna do?!
Of course... We'll crush the laboratory!
Oh, you came at the right time...\nWe've got a report that the people prisoned in\nCuervo Jail are gonna be executed as partisans...
They are charged as the terrorists who attacked\nBrahe's laboratory and vandalized the equipment...
They must be trying to pay us back by ruining our\nreputation by killing the innocent people...\nDammit!!
So what're you gonna do?\nGo help them, right?
Wait. It's their trap.\nThey must be trying to provoke us and catch us all\nwhen we attack... Don't be fooled by them.
But if we didn't go, they could be killed, right?!\nAre you sure?
Anyway! It's true that innocent people are being\ntortured and going to be executed.\nI'm going! Okay, captain?!
What are you doing? Come on!
Do you want the good news or bad news first?
The security in Ultimea has got tightened and\nwe can't walk outside easily.\nThe reason must be related the good news though...
It's really a great news!\nThe empress is going to make a speech at the\nsquare in Ultimea City tomorrow.
In fact, they are setting up the venue at\nthe square.
What?! The empress shows up?!\nShe rarely gets out side of the palace!
We can't miss this opportunity!\nWoo hoo!!
Wait a minute.\nYou said that the empress rarely go outside right?
But now she's coming to the square in the center\nof the town, not even the place garden...?
It sounds too good to be true, doesn't it?\nIsn't it their plan to lure you?
Pelulu, I bet you didn't listen to Pasca.
They are setting up the venue at the square for\nthe speech.
They won't make such a large-scale trap just to\ncatch us.
What? I did! I did but...
What? I did! I did but...\nHmm, am I thinking too much??
...After the incident at the jail, the number of\nour partisans has greatly decreased, so it's\ndifficult to fight back their military force...
But this is why we must take a chance to\nget the empress even if it was a bait!!
But...The army of El Scaro and resistance fighters\nin Klaspe Slum are supposed to be coming.\nShouldn't we wait for them...?
If they knew that the our forces were coming,\nthey would evacuate the empress somewhere.
We could be able to break down the empire but\nwe can't be satisfied with it...
We must kill the empress with our own hands for\nthe deceased fellow partisans and families!!
No worries, Pelulu.\nIt could be a little dangerous but it's also\na great chance to avenge our friends!
The empress... You won't be laughing tomorrow!\nBe prepared!! Even if we were trapped, we'll\nbreak through them!!
...?! You'll go separately?! Why?\n...Hmm, their backup may come. That could happen.\nAlright. I'll leave it to you.
Give us the signal if they come.\nHa ha, I know. We all don't wanna fall down.
Then, you guys stand by at a roof in the city.\nYou'll able to see even narrow streets.\nSo, you'll notice if the empire army comes.
I'm sorry that we can't fight together but\nI'm counting on your backup.
Okay, let's call it a day.\nRest up for the tomorrow's mission.\nGot it?
Oh? What's wrong? You're gonna start the mission\nnext morning? Good luck! But don't waste your life!
He's seriously injured...\nHe's tough so he survived, but his condition is\nunstable...
I need to take care of him all the time for\na while...
*sigh* This is not the first time when fellow\npartisans passed out and this town went quiet...
But gods... Isn't it too much...?\nDid they have to die till this town becomes quiet\nlike this?
Hey. Don't you think I'm an outsider after you\ninvolved me to it.
But, isn't it too reckless to attack Ultimea\nonly with you and me?
Then, we'll help you with it...
Are you sure?\nIt means you betray the Black Knights...\nand your country, right?
My purpose of life is to protect Lufenas family...\nI volunteered for the Black Knights to...
To become strong enough to protect Ms. Triet...\nRight?
Y-You're a female black knight, right?\nHow could I expect this...\nYou're so beautiful...
...So, you feel no regret for quitting.
I can tell from your face. You think you are a\nblack knight but you didn't pledge allegiance\nto a tyrant who kills innocent people!
Fine. I feel you...\nLet's bring an end to this...\nYou too, of course.
You guys! Don't waste your life!!\nI don't want any more victims!
We'll be fine, grandma.\nTake care of Lepage, please!
You'll go to the Empress's now?\nDo not risk you life. And don't forget that I'm\nwaiting for you here!
Ha ha ha! Hey, Nino! This is why I told you.\nThey'll be scared if we go back to here suddenly!
Ha ha... I'm so sorry.\nI didn't think you'd be surprised like this.\nSorry, Pelulu. And... I'm home.
Is it really you, Nino... Pasca...?\nI thought you were...
Well, when the Demi Machina fell down to us,\nthe ground collapse and we fell in a water tank\nor something. That's why we were safe.
We walked through the waterway but it was like a\nlabyrinth and we were lost.\nThen, we finally got out of there.
I don't care!\nI'm so glad that you're alive...
Romfh should be happy if he knew you were safe...\nAhhhhhh! What a relieeef!
Y-You guys... You came back safe...
By the way, what happened to the Empress?
What?! You drove her away?!\nThat's great! ...But many things happened.\nI can tell from his face...
So, what are you guys going to do from now?
...I see. Report to the King Elbano...\nCan I go with you?
Now that they're gone...\nI'll have nothing to live on.
No, you guys stay with Lepage and Ms. Adala...
The army of El Scaro and partisans Claspe Slum\nwill reach here soon to subdue the remnants of\nLyark...
Someone needs to tell them the situation to\ncarry out the mission quickly, right?
Oh, right!\nThey know nothing about Ultimea!!
So, we'll be of their help!!
Well! It's gonna be busy again!\nI've gotta prepare for welcoming them.\nGuys, give me a hand!
Now, you are the new captain!\nSo, get well soon!!
Ouch!! It's not a serious injury for me!!\n...But I need your supports...
Sure! You can count on me!\nI would become a captain by the time you recover♪
Pelulu, you're going to chase the empress with\nthe adventurer, right? Good luck!
When we fell to the water tank, I heard you\nshout in anger...\nI felt happy when you got angry at them for me...
You must value your life for Romfh and the\npartisans of Hora Diomedea...
Hey, Nino. Your weapon is broken, right?\nMaybe you need the hammer I got, no?
Oh, that's fine.\nThe hammer is broken but I have this!
Yes, it's the captain's.\nMaybe it flew from the square.\nI picked it up at the sewer...
I think I'm gonna use this lance and fight\ntogether with the captain. Is it weird?
I don't think so?\nBut I'm worried if you can become strong enough\nto wield the great lance, you know?
What?! You'll be surprised to see it!

Oh, wassup? *Sigh...So busy.\nThe partisans from Klaspe Slum got here before\nthe troops of El Scaro.
I've been trying to suppress the surviving\nempress' army hiding all around Ultimea to conduct\na guerrilla war, but there are just too many.
Hmm...? My injury? Ooh, don't worry. I recover\nfast. It's always been like that and Adala also\nknows that. There aren't any aftereffects either!
Anyway, it's unbelievable that that empress is\nactually a monster...Well, only a monster would\ncome up with such a crazy massive trap tho...
She escaped to Eldenbaum right? Alright! I'll\nhurry to get rid of the empress' army so that we\nthe partisans can avenge our captain and comrades!

Yo! It's been a while, hasn't it??
My sister from another mother, Pelulu!!
You came at the right time!\nLepage, let's ask them to help us too!
What? What is it?! Is it going to make me rich?!
Hmm...no, it's not what you think...The thing is\nsince the transition of Lyark from an empire to\na republic,
and since Dr. Brahe was gone, the production of\nDemi Machinas was said to have stopped.
But, a massive Demi Machina outbreak is said to\nhave spread from around the Buried Tower to the\nrest of the place.
The problem doesn't stop there. The deepest area\nof Morga Wasteland is also said to be looking like\nsomething that doesn't belong to this world.
We were talking about going to see it for\nourselves, but it seems dangerous.\nPlus, we can't take Nino with us.
Lepage and I don't feel safe if it's just us, so\nwe're still thinking about it...
So are you guys willing to go with us?\nWe'll feel safer if you guys are around...
What the...so it's really not about getting rich.\nI don't think I wanna go with you guys.\nWhat do you say?
Okay then, I'll stay here with Pelulu, my sis!
Oh, that's unusual.\nNormally you would insist on coming with us...
W-what? Am I usually like that? A-ahahaha...\nIt's too bad cuz it seems that I might find\nsomething interesting too if I go...
Hey, you don't sound like you mean it, you know...
Oh w-what? R-really...?\nI didn't realize it at all.\nA-ahahahahaha!
Alright then, we'll stay here.\nI don't think I would find any treasure even if I\ngo with you. Besides, it's kinda scary...
Okay then, please watch this place!
Oh, you two look so happy.\nDid something good happen?
Tee hee hee...One, two, three and ta-da!!
Haha, while staying here, we went to mine some\nGoddess Beads and we got a heap of high quality\nbeads!
Then we sold them in Einklang and we got so much\nmoney! Right??
Oh, that's why I thought it was unusual that you\ndidn't wanna come with us.\nApparently, you've got this plan.
Phew, I guess they're luckier than us this time...
